The {{PAGENAME}} was introduced in the [[Changelog:V2.2.7.123661|Week 132 Update]], becoming the first firearm added to the [[Workshop]], and was introduced alongside the [[9mm CHAC Ammo Box]] (Previously called Jacketed Workshop Pistol Ammo).

When the pistol was first introduced, it only held 4 rounds and had a slightly slower reload speed at 2.65 seconds.



==Description==
The {{PAGENAME}} is an advanced handgun with increased projectile and critical damage that is comparable, or better than other [[:Category:Tier 4|Tier 4]] [[:Category:Firearms|Firearms]].

It fires any [[:Category:9mm Rounds|9mm Rounds]] including [[9mm CHAC Ammo]] that can also be purchased from the [[Workshop]].

"The CHAC Pistol is overall, a steady and reliable weapon. While it provides lower damage per shot than a rifle or high-tier bow, it compensates with a fast fire rate and even faster reload speed for situations that require quick reactions. "<ref name="dev" />

==Obtaining==
The {{PAGENAME}} must be researched and purchased from the [[Workshop]] and brought down to the planet in a Prospector's loadout or requested with the [[Orbital Exchange Interface]].

==Repair==
As with most Workshop items, it can be repaired while on orbit using {{Icon link|Ren|notext}} or down on the planet using a [[Workshop Repair Kit]] at the [[Repair Bench]].
